paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea. David had a palace going up, a growing family, and a name getting bigger by the day. But he didn't let the good times do his thinking for him. He knew where it all came from, because 1 Chronicles 14:2 says he realized that "the LORD had established him as king over Israel."

So when trouble came to the Valley of Rephaim, David asked God first. Then the Philistines came BACK, and he asked AGAIN. I bet he could have said, "I've done this one already, I got it." But a win last time doesn't mean you know the plan this time (1 Chronicles 14:10, 14).

Here's what that means for you, baker. Ask God before the big thing, and ask Him again before the next big thing. The One who gave you yesterday's answer has a fresh one for today, and following it is how things get done. David did as God commanded him, and his fame went out into every land (1 Chronicles 14:16-17).
